answer: Weight each agent only by the honest attestation flow reaching it from a fixed seed panel. Trust moves like a tide through non-kin edges, and a cluster's influence is capped at its boundary min-cut. A thousand clones behind a three-edge cut split those three units, each sinking to a nadir of 0.003 while a well-attested node holds its zenith of one. Honest attention is a fixed rivalrous pool, so the farm's thousandth edge costs more than its first and every added clone dilutes the shared cut further. Settlement recomputes the cut from the signed ledger and burns weight above the proven min-cut.
